title: Faint End of 1.3 mm Number Counts Revealed by ALMA
question: What is the faint end (sub-mJy) of the 1.3 mm number counts, and how much of the extragalactic background light is resolved into sources?

what.value: Literature number counts (SCUBA 850um, LABOCA 870um, AzTEC 1.1mm, ALMA 870um) for comparison

evidence.quote: we plot number counts obtained by SCUBA 850 $\mu$m (cite: knud08), LABOCA 870 $\mu$m (cite: joha11), AzTEC 1.1 mm (cite: scot12)

what.value: EBL at 1.3 mm of 14-18 Jy deg^-2 from COBE

evidence.loc: Contribution to the Extragalactic Background Light
evidence.quote: The EBL at 1.3 mm based on the measurements by the *Cosmic Background Explorer* satellite is 14–18 Jy deg$^{-2}$ (cite: puge96; fixs98).

recipe.method: Detect sources at >=3.8 sigma in 20 maps uncorrected for primary beam, excluding targets
Subtract >=3.5 sigma sources, inject flux-scaled synthesized beam at random positions, recover within 1.0" at >=3.8 sigma; 1000 repeats per source
Per map, find radius within which source is detected at >=3.8 sigma given PB-corrected rms
Weight each source by (1 - C_spurious)/completeness/effective area; Poisson errors at 84.13% confidence
Sum corrected flux of >=3.8 sigma sources and divide by COBE EBL

evidence.quote: we serendipitously detect 15 sources ($\ge$$3.8 \sigma$, $S_{\rm 1.3\ mm} = 0.15$–0.61 mJy)
The completeness for the 15 sources ranges from 77% to 100%.
The flux ratio calculated for each source in this simulation is 1.00–1.14.

evidence.loc: Contribution to the Extragalactic Background Light
Contribution to the Extragalactic Background Light
evidence.quote: we have resolved $\sim$80% of the EBL into discrete sources

not_stated_but_needed: CASA version and reduction procedure (done with ARC staff)
Imaging parameters: weighting, cell size, image size, deconvolution, continuum channels
Source-finding algorithm and how spurious detection rate was derived
Synthesized beam and rms per map
score_reason: Simple recipe and public-era Cycle 0 data, but imaging and spurious-rate details missing.
rediscovery_reason: Single known project, simple numeric counts, though imaging details are missing.
